title: voltmod plugin.json
description: A VoltMod plugin's identity. The host reads the installed copy strictly: an unknown key refuses the plugin.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. The host ignores it.

name.description: The plugin's directory under addons/voltmod/plugins/ and its CMake target; all three match.

logTag.description: Prefix of every log line from this plugin. Default: the name.

description.description: One line, printed after the version by `volt list`.

author.description: Credit. The host does not print it.

website.description: The plugin's page or repository. Credit, like author.

license.description: An SPDX id such as MIT, or proprietary. Credit only.

logLevel.description: The level the plugin starts at. `volt log <name> <level>` changes it until the next load.

dependencies.description: Plugins this one is refused without.

optionalDependencies.description: Plugins it is better with; never a reason to refuse it.

database.description: Where `voltmod database header` reads migrations and writes table specs. The host ignores it.
